verdicts.source: R61 已 trailing-strip - ADR-111 shift dual-label (2026-08-13)
verdicts._note: The R61 已 aspect-particle strip (the greedy-trim companion to 启动, mirrored from TW R38) shifts this c2 finding from 评估任务已 to 评估任务 on the SAME claim. The defect is REAL and is preserved: claim 2 introduces 认证任务 (authentication task) and then references 所述评估任务 (evaluation task), which has no antecedent anywhere in c1 or c2 - a genuine 专利法实施细则 antecedent defect. The shift makes the emitted term strictly more correct: 所述评估任务 is exactly the reference form the drafter wrote, where 评估任务已 was a dirty capture carrying the aspect marker.

GOLD LABEL ON AN OVER-STRICT READING. c4 introduces the element article-less in item (a) - '所述输入电压端子被配置成耦接至电压源' - and then references '来自所述电压源的输入电压'. The article-less first mention is a valid introduction under 审查指南 第二部分第二章 3.2.2, so the reference has antecedent basis. The R63 paren-asymmetry mirror lets the two spellings meet. Same on c5/c9. Claim read 2026-08-17.

Christopher's ruling 2026-10-23: in CN an article-less earlier mention in the chain is an introduction. c1 reads 通过操作杆的操作, so 所述操作杆 in c5/c7 has basis. Surfaced by the R72 而 cut, which now leaves 操作 as an over-captured stem the short-stem guard declines; the reference resolves through the article-less mention. Claim read 2026-10-24.

c122 introduces the element as 具有预定面积和结合并固定目标实体的结合点 (relative-clause intro, bare-noun arm 3, which no intro arm captures yet) and c123 mentions 结合点 article-less, so 所述结合点 in c124 has basis. Claim read 2026-10-24.

Each claim first says 延伸相应的第二长度 / 相应的第四长度, an article-less introduction under the 2026-10-23 ruling, before 所述第二长度 / 所述第四长度 in the same claim. The R72 而 cut lets that intro be captured cleanly. Claim read 2026-10-24.

A REAL defect the prefix fallback had been hiding: c11 (dependent on c1) refers to 所述混合器, and nothing in c1 introduces a mixer; the fallback resolved it against the 2-char stem 混合 from the verb 混合 (to mix). The R72 short-stem guard surfaces it. Claim read 2026-10-24.
